surface_mechanism_description: The growth of ZnO based on these reactions is known to be surface reaction limited. The chemistry for the ALE growth of ZnO using these precursors has been known as: DeZn pulse: S /C0OH + Zn(CH2CH3)2 → S /C0O /C0Zn(CH2CH3) + C2H6. Water pulse: S /C0O /C0Zn(CH2CH3) + H2O → S /C0O /C0Zn /C0OH + C2H6. The growth of ZnO based on these reactions is known to be surface reaction limited.
